title: Decided appends: the race windows of section 45 (D-2026-115..118)
note: DA1-DA8: each repair that moved a decision under the writer lock or stopped attributing a concurrent supervisor's write, reopened one at a time. DA13-DA14: the head witness's temp file is a supervisor's, and a name pattern stays at its own depth (D-2026-123). DA9-DA12: a stamped grant rebuilt by replay's own constructor before it is written, and a one-action grant's lifetime counted from its stamp. tests/test_decided_appends.py opens each window deterministically, so a kill does not depend on a race being lost.

mutations.name: DA1_a_move_is_decided_against_what_its_caller_read
mutations.find:
proj = self.projection()
            decided_against["projection"] = proj
            cur = proj.tasks.get(task.task_id)
mutations.replace:
proj = self.projection()
            decided_against["projection"] = proj
            cur = task
mutations.rationale: a task another process moved since this caller read it is moved again from the state the caller saw: a record the replay cannot apply

mutations.name: DA2_a_lost_bind_runs_its_own_task_anyway
mutations.rationale: a submission that lost the bind to another process runs the request a second time under the other's key

mutations.name: DA3_the_lookup_answers_from_the_ledger_of_construction
mutations.rationale: a binding another runner made after this one was built is invisible, so the request is submitted a second time

mutations.name: DA4_the_bind_is_decided_from_a_stale_ledger
mutations.rationale: a key bound in the window before this bind is bound again, which replay refuses on every load

mutations.name: DA5_the_checkpoint_snapshots_a_position_behind_its_anchor
mutations.rationale: a record that landed just before the lock is missing from the snapshot of the position the checkpoint anchors

mutations.name: DA6_a_misdescribing_checkpoint_stops_the_restart
mutations.find:
except StoreError as exc:
                # A checkpoint the audit could not fault
mutations.replace:
except ZeroDivisionError as exc:
                # A checkpoint the audit could not fault
mutations.rationale: a checkpoint whose snapshot does not describe its anchor makes the restart raise instead of replaying

mutations.name: DA7_the_runner_does_not_name_its_own_stores
mutations.rationale: a concurrent supervisor's append to the shared log fails whichever tool was running

mutations.name: DA8_the_sweep_charges_every_change_to_the_tool
mutations.rationale: the supervisor stores named to the sweep are inventoried anyway, and their changes charged to the tool

mutations.name: DA9_capability_written_without_replays_check
mutations.rationale: a grant the stamp moved past its own expiry is appended, and every replay of the log refuses it

mutations.name: DA10_egress_grant_written_without_replays_check
mutations.rationale: an egress grant stamped past its own expiry is appended, and every replay of the log refuses it

mutations.name: DA11_secret_grant_written_without_replays_check
mutations.rationale: a secret grant stamped past its own expiry is appended, and every replay of the log refuses it

mutations.name: DA12_lifetime_ignored
mutations.find:
if lifetime_seqs is not None:
                c = replace(c, expires_after_seq=c.issued_seq
mutations.rationale: a one-action grant asked to live four positions from its stamp is minted with no expiry at all

mutations.name: DA13_a_pattern_covers_subdirectories
mutations.rationale: a supervisor's name pattern also covers files in directories below it, which a tool could write unseen

mutations.name: DA14_the_runner_does_not_name_the_witness_temp
mutations.rationale: another supervisor's head-witness temp file, there for an instant during its append, is charged to the running tool and its run refused (D-2026-123)
